attacks.name: Gore
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
Before |!damage| is dealt, Place this character within |!range| 1 of the target character.

superPowers.name: Stampede
superPowers.body: This character is Pushed |!range_medium|. It does not stop its movement if it contacts a Size 2 or smaller interactive terrain feature. Instead, the contacted terrain feature is destroyed, then this character continues being Pushed. The next time it makes a Gore attack this turn, add 2 dice to the attack roll. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Nobody Ever Accused the Rhino of Good Manners
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of Size 4 or less and within |!range| 2 and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Aggressive
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting this character is resolved, if this character suffered |!damage|, it may Advance |!range_small| Toward the attacking character.

superPowers.name: Ornery
superPowers.body: When this character is damaged by an enemy or allied effect, after the effect is resolved, if it is not Dazed, it gains 1 |!power|.

superPowers.name: Rhino Hide
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1.
